data.long_meaning: The name Gebhardt is derived from the Old German words Geb meaning 'given' and hard meaning 'brave, strong'. The name is therefore translated as 'given by God' or 'bold, brave gift from God'. The name Gebhardt carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gebhardt usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
